story.title: Room to breathe, close to everything
story.imageAlt: Lake and forest landscape in the Tahko region
story.paragraph1: We're a family who knows these slopes and shores by heart — and we look after every villa and apartment ourselves, from your first message to the keys in your hand.
story.paragraph2: Our Tahko villas are made for sauna evenings, firelit nights and slow mornings by the water, with the slopes and trails just minutes away. Our Uusimaa apartments keep work trips and city breaks effortless.
story.paragraph3: We do not offer instant online booking. Instead, we respond to every inquiry personally and help you find the right property for your dates.

editorial.title: By the lake, close to the slopes
editorial.subtitle: Sauna evenings, firelit nights and the hush of the forest — three very different villas, one easy choice.
editorial.imageAlt: Tahko landscape — lake and forest around a holiday home

trust.item1Text: Heat the wood sauna, cool off in the lake, and watch the evening settle over the water — the heart of every Tahko stay.
trust.item2Text: Ski runs in winter, hiking and biking trails in summer, and the lakeshore close by all year round.
trust.item3Text: One family looks after every home and replies to you within a day or two — no call centre, no platform fees.

metadata.title: FAQ | Tahko Villas
metadata.description: Frequently asked questions about Tahko Villas holiday homes and the booking process.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about accommodation, booking and practical details.

pets.question: Are pets allowed?
pets.answer: Pets are welcome at some of our properties. Please mention your pet in your inquiry so we can confirm a suitable property. An additional fee or separate terms may apply.

bedLinens.question: Are bed linens included?
bedLinens.answer: Yes — bed linen and towels are usually included in the price. Any exceptions are stated in your booking confirmation.

checkInOut.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkInOut.answer: Check-in from 4:00 PM and check-out by 12:00 PM. Different times can be arranged in advance when the schedule allows.

cleaning.question: What cleaning is expected at departure?
cleaning.answer: We ask you to wash dishes, empty bins and sort recycling. Final cleaning is included in the price. Exceptionally messy departures may incur an additional charge.

keys.question: How does key handover work?
keys.answer: We send detailed instructions and a key code or collection details by email before arrival. We are available on arrival day if needed.

kitchen.question: What is provided in the kitchen?
kitchen.answer: Kitchens are fully equipped: stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, basic tableware and utensils. A detailed list is provided in your booking confirmation.

cancellation.question: What is the cancellation policy?
cancellation.answer: Cancellation terms vary by property and season. Exact terms are always confirmed in writing before the booking is binding.

booking.question: How do I book?
booking.answer: Choose a property and send an inquiry via the form or contact page with your preferred dates. We confirm availability personally and send booking terms by email. Payment and final confirmation are handled directly through Tahko Villas.

cta.title: Didn't find your answer?
cta.subtitle: Send us a message — we are happy to help.

metadata.title: Departure day guide | Tahko Villas
metadata.description: Check-out and final cleaning instructions for Tahko Villas holiday homes on departure day.

checkout.title: Departure day guide
checkout.subtitle: Follow these steps for a smooth departure and a warm welcome for the next guest.

checkout.title: Check-out guide
steps: Check-out time on departure day is 12:00 PM.
Pack all your belongings. Check under beds and sofas too.
Empty the fridge of food.
Wash the dishes. The dishwasher may stay on when you leave — we will empty it for you.
Take rubbish to the bin and remove empty bottles and cans.
Return furniture to its original places.
Make sure the yard is tidy and outdoor items are in place. Clean the grill if you used it.
If anything was damaged, let us know by email or via the contact form.
If you rented linens from us, strip the beds and leave them in a neat pile in the hallway.
Complete final cleaning as below. If you booked cleaning with us, you can skip this section.
Return the cottage key as instructed — thank you.

cleaning.title: Final cleaning if you clean yourself
cleaning.intro: Final cleaning is usually included in the price. If you agreed to clean yourself, please follow the instructions below.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
steps: Wash dishes and put them away dry in the cupboards.
Empty waste bins and clean the bin and cupboard.
Empty and clean the fridge and freezer.
Clean the stove, oven and microwave.
Check the coffee maker, kettle and toaster.
Turn off washing machine and dishwasher taps.

other.title: Other rooms
steps: Return furniture to its original places.
Shake rugs and bedding outside if needed.
Remove cold ashes from fireplaces.
Clean the sauna, washroom and bathroom if needed.
Clean the toilet, sink and mirrors.
Vacuum floors — including under beds, cabinets and the sofa.
Wipe table and counter surfaces and cabinet doors.
Clean windows if marked. Mop floors with a damp cloth.
Close all windows and doors.
Make beds with aired bedding and day covers.

outdoor.title: Outdoor areas
steps: Clean the grill after each use to prevent rust.
If a pet stayed with you, please keep the yard tidy as well.

cleaning.note: Please make sure the next guest can arrive comfortably without extra cleaning. Thank you!

metadata.title: Privacy policy | Tahko Villas
metadata.description: How Tahko Villas processes personal data submitted through our website and inquiry forms.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: This notice explains how we handle your personal data when you contact us or request accommodation.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: The data controller is Tahko Villas. For privacy matters, contact us at {email}.

dataCollected.title: Data we collect
dataCollected.body: We collect the details you provide in contact and booking inquiry forms, such as your name, email, phone number, message content, chosen property, and preferred dates. Basic server logs (e.g. IP address) may also be generated.

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.body: We use your data to respond to inquiries, handle booking requests, communicate with guests, and improve our service. We do not sell your data for marketing lists.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.body: Processing is based on steps prior to entering a contract and contract performance (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)) and our legitimate interest in responding to customer requests (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)).

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We keep inquiry data for as long as needed to handle your request and maintain the customer relationship, typically up to 24 months from your last contact, unless a longer period is required by law.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell personal data. Data may be processed by service providers (e.g. email and hosting) within the EU/EEA or with appropriate safeguards. Only necessary information is shared.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or object to processing where applicable by law. You may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Privacy requests and questions: {email}. We aim to respond as soon as possible.
